item.description: Hey HN, this is Andy from Respan ( https://www.respan.ai ). We are building an open-source Rust AI gateway. It is a decoupled gateway, so everything is a plugin, including different providers, protocols (MCP, voice), modalities (images, videos), and gateway features (fallbacks, PII redaction, smart routing). Instead of packaging tons of providers and features into one gateway, Respan provides a small core and public interfaces that teams can use to assemble the AI infrastructure their application needs. That way, users can build their own features as additional plugins without having to… Fuente: Hacker News - Portada.

item.title: Marie Curie y Einstein se escribieron cartas durante más de 20 años. 100 años después podemos leer lo que se decían
item.description: El 7 de julio de 1922, Marie Curie le escribió a Albert Einstein para echarle la bronca. Con buenas formas, sí; pero bronca al fin y al cabo: Curie le llegaba a decir que le había causado una 'gran decepción'. Durante 21 años, dos de los científicos más importantes de la historia se escribieron cartas en las que apenas se hablaba de física. Lo que hicieron fue cubrirse las espaldas. Y ahora, un siglo después, podemos leer la historia completa. ¿"Una gran decepción"? item.title: France riots: AI photos falsely depict elderly couple ‘stripped and robbed’
item.description: AI-generated photos falsely claiming to show an elderly couple being “stripped and robbed” during unrest in France have racked up millions of views. Amplified by far-right accounts, the images fuelled inflammatory claims about Muslims, Jews and the riots. The FRANCE 24 Observers traced one image to an AI photo montage published by a pro-Israel account. The images were created using OpenAI tools, and the alleged assault remains unverified, with no official reports confirming the attack. Fuente: France 24 - English.
